reviews.finding: answerElab calls google.answer.get(getOptions), reading the distinct google.answer option only. It does not test pp.unicode.fun or compare the whole Options map. The option controls statement-answer handling and is semantically meaningful; its unchanged effective/default value must remain part of the future exact semantic-option qualification. This specific pp.unicode.fun difference does not select a different answer mode in this accessor.
reviews.scope_caveat: The helper has a canonical sorry constructor for certain answer modes. Its source existence does not classify any selected theorem as admitted; actual endpoint axioms and mode/source scope must be preserved.

reviews.finding: The run_cmd obtains the environment, reads literal constructor docstrings for subject codes0..97, builds a newline-joined String, and elaborates the exposed meta definition amsSubjects. It does not read options or delaborate/pretty-print an expression. The two unicode function-arrow print styles do not enter this data-generation path.
